topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I knew the moment I saw their faces, the way they looked at me with those hesitant eyes. I’d been so excited, counting down the days, picturing all our friends, the laughter, the music. I should have noticed the subtle changes in their behavior, the less frequent updates, the excuses for why they couldn’t meet up. But I was too caught up, too hopeful. Now, the silence is deafening. The party’s off, and I’m left with a house decorated with the remnants of a plan that fizzled out. I wish I could go back and do things differently, maybe not push so hard, give them a different kind of support. But here I am, untangling the decorations, wondering where it all went wrong.
